shortBio.en: MBV guitar/producer; tremolo-arm blur and Loveless studio method.
shortBio.zh: MBV 吉他/制作；颤音臂模糊与 Loveless 录音室方法。

body.en:
Born 1963. Jazzmaster/tremolo pitch glide, sampled guitar stacks, buried vocals. Loveless (1991) is the production ceiling citation; studio time is part of the historical object.

Method: texture as composition.
body.zh:
1963 年生。Jazzmaster/颤音臂音高滑动、采样吉他堆叠、埋人声。Loveless（1991）是制作上限引用；录音室时间是历史对象的一部分。

方法：纹理即作曲。
